crossRefs.note: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.
You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in…
the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.
In all things be showing yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, be showing integrity, seriousness…

But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you…
When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of…
For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.
“For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.
by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.
Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,
Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and…
But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.
being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living…
For if he who comes preaches another Jesus, whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit, which you…
in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to…
My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of…
I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by…
and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with much…
You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
To them it was revealed, that they served not to themselves, but to you, in these things, which now have been announced…
For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve…
Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.
I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them…
Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection…
My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
